description: AI that reads commercial lease PDFs and flags high-risk clauses for tenants in under 2 minutes
pricing: $75 per report. $199/month unlimited (for brokers and teams). No subscription required for single reports.
notes: Built for small business tenants and tenant rep brokers. Analyzes 15+ risk categories including CAM charges, personal guarantee scope, holdover rates, rent escalation, renewal deadlines.
